info.title: Odyssey Ops API
info.description: Restaurant operations API — menu, orders, customers, settings, metrics.

200.description: Menu categories, ordered by sort order

patch.summary: Update a menu item (price, name, availability, …)

get.summary: List customers with order count and total spend
Get a customer with stats and recent orders
List orders with optional status / customer / date filters

post.summary: Create an order (server computes totals, validates availability)

get.summary: Get full order detail with line items and customer

post.summary: Advance an order through a valid status action

get.summary: Dashboard KPIs: orders, revenue, pending, popular items, recent orders
